verdict.rationale: Choosing a specific model instead of automatic selection is a fair question for a coding-agent platform like Codegen, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions model selection, model pinning or an automatic-routing setting. The agent behavior and permissions settings, the SDK `agent.run(prompt=...)` call, and the CLI wrapping of Claude Code do not document any way to choose a model.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can switch away from automatic model selection to a specific model of my choice
